alt: Jennifer Lopez posing in a composite image flanked by two oversized pink Beso Bling lip balm containers decorated with large Swarovski crystals — JLo Beauty's $150 limited-edition version of their $19 original lip balm
story: On November 5, 2026, JLo Beauty released Beso Bling — three limited-edition lip balms encrusted with Swarovski crystals, each priced at $150 (or $225 for the set), compared to the $19 Beso Balm they're based on — accompanied by a surreal AI-generated promo video labeled 'AI content' that showed cherries rolling through subway cars and crystal-covered hummingbirds, prompting critics to call it 'the dumbest product launch in history.'
why_funny: JLo Beauty's answer to 'how do we innovate our lip balm?' was: apply Swarovski crystals to the same formula and charge eight times as much, then hire an AI to write the ad because apparently the concept required no human creativity either.
